exposure: Pregnant women with poor sleep quality
Pregnant women with vitamin D deficiency
outcome: Sleep quality (measured by the Pittsburgh Sleep Questionnaire)
cohort: 92 pregnant women in their last trimester at the Maternity Clinic of Turgut Ozal University, Ankara, Turkey
finding: Although inadequate vitamin D and poor sleep quality are prevalent in pregnant women, low levels of vitamin D are not associated with poor sleep quality.
mod_finding: There was no significant association between vitamin D deficiency and mode of delivery.
